title: The image of a C¹ map ℝⁿ → ℝ^P is covered, up to an Hⁿ-null set, by countably many bi-Lipschitz open charts (Simon Ch. 3, proof of Lemma 1.2: critical image and inverse-function step; Remark 1.3)
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ (ℝᵏ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k); Hⁿ = μHE[n], Mathlib's Euclidean-normalised n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P) and let G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be of class C¹. Then there are open sets O_k ⊆ ℝⁿ (k ∈ ℕ) with the following properties. For every k, G is Lipschitz on O_k with some constant K_k ≥ 0, and G is antilipschitz on O_k: there is c_k > 0 with c_k|w − w′| ≤ |G(w) − G(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ O_k. Moreover Hⁿ(G(ℝⁿ) ∖ ⋃_k G(O_k)) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (G : Eucl n → Eucl P), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∃ O : ℕ → Set (Eucl n), (∀ k, IsOpen (O k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K G (O k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ O k, ∀ w' ∈ O k, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖G w - G w'‖) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (range G \ ⋃ k, G '' O k) = 0
